description.value: The Courthouse Inn is a boutique inn set in the historic core of Revelstoke, furnished with handcrafted local fir beds and Canadiana antiques, with a gourmet 3-course breakfast included in every stay. Situated in a mountain town celebrated for its cycling, skiing, and national park access, it offers a warm, lodge-style alternative to standard hotels. Touring cyclists will find dedicated bike storage and a boot/glove dryer on-site as standard inclusions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly lists 'Ski & Bike Storage' as a standard included amenity on the front page, confirming bike storage exists; the King Suite amenities page adds 'Boot and glove dryer with ski storage available,' suggesting a dedicated storage/drying area. Wi-Fi is confirmed via 'Wireless internet available throughout the Inn' and corroborated by the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No evidence was found for laundry, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash, so those remain null.
concerns: Bike storage is described simply as 'Ski & Bike Storage' — no details on whether it is locked or secured; may warrant a follow-up call to confirm security level for WWC purposes.
FAQ references a Covid-19-related room service suspension, suggesting some website content may not have been fully updated.
OSM address omits the PO Box (Box 2256) present on the contact page, but street address and postal code match.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Revelstoke is a premier cycling destination and the inn explicitly lists bike storage as a standard included amenity, making it a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The inn accommodates children 12 and older and does not allow pets. A 10% CAA member discount is mentioned on the FAQ page.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Website front page lists 'Ski & Bike Storage' as a standard included amenity; King Suite amenities page also lists 'Boot and glove dryer with ski storage available.' Security details (locked vs. unlocked) are not specified

Drying area.detail: King Suite amenities page lists 'Boot and glove dryer with ski storage available,' indicating a dedicated drying facility for gear
